newsitem.title: USA: Securitek buys night vision product maker.
newsitem.headline: Securitek buys night vision product maker.

text.p: Securitek International Corp said Thursday that it has agreed to buy the assets of Barrett & Blandford Associates Inc, a maker of military night vision products, for about $500,000.

The acquisition includes machinery, plant equipment, inventory and an order backlog of more than $3.5 million, Securitek said. Barrett & Blandford will continue negotiating sales to countries such as Greece, Turkey, Pakistan, Portugal, Korea, Australia, Canada, Singapore and certain Central and South American countries after the acquisition, Securitek said.
Securitek, formerly called U.S. Asset Corp, said the buy will be made through a new subsidiary, Barrett Precision Optical Inc, and should be completed in 30 days.
Barrett & Blandford is based in New Jersey and has facilities in Anderson, South Carolina, Securitek said.

Securitek designs and markets security and surveillance systems for the military, government and law enforcement. The company said it would continue to seek acquisitions of companies involved in the security industry.
Securitek said the international market for night vision devices exceeds $1 billion a year.
